# Twitch Streamer Dashboard Redesign

## Current Pain Points to Address
- Scattered information across multiple tabs
- Delayed analytics data
- Poor real-time chat/moderation integration
- Overwhelming for new streamers
- Limited customization

---

## 1. **Core Layout Structure**

### Left Sidebar (Quick Controls)
- **Stream Status** (live/offline toggle, uptime)
- **Quick Settings** (game, title, tags)
- **Audio Mixer** (simplified)
- **Scene Switcher**
- **Notifications Panel**

### Main Feed (3 Column Approach)
- **Center**: Live preview + chat overlay
- **Right Column A**: Real-time analytics
- **Right Column B**: Moderation tools

---

## 2. **Key Dashboard Sections**

### A. **At-a-Glance Widget**
```
┌─────────────────────────────┐
│ 📊 STREAM HEALTH            │
├─────────────────────────────┤
│ Viewers: 234 ↑ 12%          │
│ Bitrate: 6.5 Mbps ✓         │
│ FPS: 60 ✓  |  CPU: 45% ⚠    │
│ Chat Health: Healthy         │
└─────────────────────────────┘
```

### B. **Real-Time Analytics**
- Viewership graph (sparkline)
- Peak viewers/average viewers
- Chat messages/min
- Follow/subscribe alerts (animated)
- Traffic source (direct, raids, search)

### C. **Chat & Moderation Hub**
- Live chat with mod tools
- Word filters active
- Automod queue
- Recent timeouts/bans
- Quick action buttons

### D. **Alerts Panel**
- Follows, subs, donations (stacked, dismissible)
- Raid notifications
- Technical warnings (bitrate drops, etc.)

---

## 3. **Enhanced Features**

### ⚡ Quick Actions Bar
```
[🎮 Switch Game] [📝 Edit Title] [🔔 Alerts On/Off] 
[⚙️ Settings] [📊 Analytics] [🤝 Share]
```

### 🎨 **Customizable Dashboard**
- Drag-and-drop widgets
- Dark/light mode
- Save multiple layouts
- Presets for different stream types

### 🔔 **Smart Notifications**
- Configurable alerts (sound, visual, banner)
- Priority levels (critical, important, info)
- Do Not Disturb mode
- Notification history/log

---

## 4. **Advanced Features**

| Feature | Benefit |
|---------|---------|
| **Raid Manager** | Queue upcoming raids, auto-accept settings |
| **Clip Generator** | Auto-highlight moments, one-click clip creation |
| **Schedule Widget** | Show upcoming stream times to viewers |
| **VOD Analytics** | Quick performance review post-stream |
| **Community Insights** | Top chatters, repeat viewers, growth trends |
| **Multi-Stream Mode** | Manage Twitch + YouTube + TikTok (if applicable) |

---

## 5. **Mobile Companion App**
- View stream performance on phone
- Approve chat messages remotely
- End stream from mobile
- Notification center

---

## 6. **Accessibility & Usability**

✅ **Keyboard shortcuts** for common actions  
✅ **Color-blind friendly** alert indicators  
✅ **Screen reader compatible**  
✅ **Onboarding tutorial** for new streamers  
✅ **Command palette** (Cmd+K) for quick access  

---

## 7. **Sample Wireframe Flow**

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ ☰ TWITCH STUDIO          Status: LIVE ● │
├──────────────┬──────────────┬──────────────┤
│   CONTROLS   │  LIVE FEED   │  ANALYTICS   │
│              │              │              │
│ [Scenes]     │              │ Views: 456 ↑ │
│ [Audio]      │   Preview    │ Chat: 45/min │
│ [Settings]   │              │ CPU: 60%     │
│              │              │              │
│  Chat        │              │ Subs: ↑ 2    │
│  ──────────  │              │              │
│  @user: hey! │              │              │
│  @mod: hi!   │              │ [Detailed]   │
└──────────────┴──────────────┴──────────────┘
```

---

## 8. **Implementation Priorities**

### Phase 1 (MVP)
- Reorganized layout
- Real-time analytics widget
- Improved chat moderation

### Phase 2
- Customizable widgets
- Advanced alerts system
- Mobile app

### Phase 3
- AI-powered insights
- Automated clip generation
- Community analytics

---

## 9. **Questions for Your Use Case**

- Are you targeting **new or experienced** streamers?
- What's your **primary device** (desktop/mobile)?
- Do you stream **single or multi-platform**?
- What's your **technical comfort level**?

Would you like me to dive deeper into any specific section?
